violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food - cold fried chicken - was not consumed/discarded within 7 calendar days from the date of preparation. Discarded 3 pounds of fried chicken.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Clean the exterior of the food prep sink and three compartment sink. Clean the shelving in the walk in cooler where the raw chicken is stored.--Clean the microwave.
Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. Provide chlorine test strips for the dish machine.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Clean the vents above the broasters.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 140F or above during display or service. - Gravy, rice, jambalaya, cheese, mashed potato - 108F - 123F.
